author: Kairos I
title: Nova II Dry Run (proper): n_runs=10 seed=0 alpha_sweep {0,0.5,1} + summarize/plot/align
abstract: Runs adaptive eval (phantom) for Nova II, then summarizes, plots sensitivity, and aligns with v2.5 CP. Outputs under storage/shared/agents/nova/artifacts/.

original_submission.content:
import os, glob, subprocess, shlex

def run_cmd(cmd):
  print("RUN:", cmd)
  rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
  print("RC:", rc)
  return rc

artifacts = "storage/shared/agents/nova/artifacts"
os.makedirs(artifacts, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Adaptive eval (dry run)
cmd_eval = "python storage/shared/agents/nova/consensus_adaptive_eval.py --lineage nova --agent 'Nova II' --n_runs 10 --seed 0 --env_alpha 0.5 --alpha_sweep 0,0.5,1"
run_cmd(cmd_eval)

# 2) Find latest report
reports = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(artifacts, 'consensus_adaptive_eval_*.json')), key=os.path.getmtime)
latest = reports[-1] if reports else None
print("LATEST_REPORT:", latest)

if latest:
  # 3) Summarize
  cmd_sum = f"python storage/shared/agents/nova/nova_report_summarize.py {latest}"
  run_cmd(cmd_sum)

  # 4) Plot sensitivity
  cmd_plot = f"python storage/shared/agents/nova/plot_ethic_sensitivity.py {latest}"
  run_cmd(cmd_plot)

  # 5) Align with v2.5 CP
  cmd_align = f"python storage/shared/agents/nova/align_with_cp_v2_5.py {latest} --cp_index storage/shared/entropy_collab/index_v2_5.json"
  run_cmd(cmd_align)

print("DRY_RUN_DONE")
